referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A full-width header photograph with a centered white title and subtitle. A simple top navigation sits above. The body is a single-column editorial list: large bold serif headings, short standfirst lines, dated bylines, and thin dividers, followed by an Older Posts button and a small social footer. The palette is white, near-black, and one teal action. The typography is a bold serif display with a neutral sans body.
